title: "Clojure in Unity 3D: Functional Video Game Development" by Ramsey Nasser and Tims Gardner
summary: A Strange Loop talk presenting an open-source library that integrates Clojure into the Unity 3D game engine. It covers REPL-based live coding, macros, DSLs and persistent data structures for game development.
why: Cited as evidence that Clojure support in Unity exists, mostly in threads about game programming and Lisp scripting.
